description: Use this to add a person to a group by name.

Color.description:
An avatar colour as an uppercase hex string. The server accepts only the
colours of its palette and answers 400 for any other; the palette can grow.

color.description: Avatar colour, or `null` for the default.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

name.description: The member's name, as the group sees it.

name: add_member
title: Add a member
